About Me

Hi! I’m S Sandhya, a second-year B.E. Computer Science and Design student at SRM Easwari Engineering College, Chennai, Tamil Nadu. I’m curious about Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, and interested in exploring how intelligent technologies can solve real-world problems. I’m also interested in Data Science, especially how data can be analysed to discover meaningful patterns and insights.

Apart from technology, I enjoy exploring UI/UX Design and Graphic Design. I’m interested in creating user-friendly interfaces and meaningful digital experiences through UI/UX, while experimenting with colours, typography and layouts to create engaging visual designs.

I’m currently gaining exposure through hackathons and technical events, where I get opportunities to explore new ideas, collaborate with teams and improve my problem-solving skills. I’m always eager to learn, experiment and grow through new experiences.

Projects

01

Smart Home Energy Optimizer

Hardware + Software Integrated Project

Smart Home Energy Optimizer is an intelligent energy management system designed to monitor household energy consumption and manage electrical appliances efficiently. It integrates Arduino hardware, sensors and Java-based software to monitor environmental conditions and support smart appliance management.

Technologies Used

JavaObject-Oriented Programming (OOP)Arduino UnoIoTSensors (LDR, DHT11, ACS712)Java Swing

Key Features

  • Monitors environmental conditions using sensors.
  • Detects light intensity and temperature.
  • Monitors current consumption.
  • Supports appliance management based on priority.
  • Provides smart suggestions to help prevent overloading.
  • Displays sensor readings and appliance status through a Java GUI.
02

SkillPass – Portable Professional Identity for Gig Workers

Software Project

SkillPass is a software-based solution designed to give gig workers a portable professional identity. It aims to help workers showcase their skills, work experience and professional reputation through a unified digital identity.

Core Focus

  • Portable professional identity for gig workers.
  • Showcasing skills and work experience.
  • Maintaining professional records.
  • Giving workers ownership of their professional reputation.
  • Reducing dependency on individual work platforms.
“The worker owns their reputation — not the platform.”
03

InfraPulse AI – AI-Powered Infrastructure Monitoring System Ongoing

Software Project

InfraPulse AI is an AI-powered infrastructure monitoring system designed to predict cost overruns and completion delays in government infrastructure projects such as highways, railways and power plants. It uses historical and current project data with Machine Learning to identify potential risks early and help government officials take preventive action.

Technologies Used

PythonPandasNumPyScikit-learnStreamlitSHAP

Core Features

  • Predicting project cost overruns and completion delays.
  • Assigning risk scores to infrastructure projects.
  • Generating alerts for high-risk projects.
  • Explaining the factors contributing to project risks.
  • Displaying project progress through an interactive dashboard.
  • Comparing project performance across different sectors.
  • Providing an AI chatbot to answer questions about project data.
  • Suggesting actions to address potential project risks.

Project Workflow

Project Data→ML Models→Risk Prediction→Alerts→Suggested Actions
“Predicting project risks today to build better infrastructure tomorrow.”
